229: func (s Service) Status(projectRef, sprintRef string) (StatusSummary, error) {
230: 	projects, err := project.DiscoverProjects(s.root)
231: 	if err != nil {
232: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
233: 	}
234: 	p, err := project.ResolveProject(projects, projectRef)
235: 	if err != nil {
236: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
237: 	}
238: 	sprints, err := DiscoverSprints(s.root, p)
239: 	if err != nil {
240: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
241: 	}
242: 	sp, err := ResolveSprint(sprints, sprintRef)
243: 	if err != nil {
244: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
245: 	}
246: 	if !inside(p.Path, sp.Path) {
247: 		return StatusSummary{}, fmt.Errorf("sprint path mismatch for %q", sp.Slug)
248: 	}
249: 	legacyCodeContextState := preCodeContextFlowState(s.root, sp)
250: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
251: 	stateLoaded := err == nil
252: 	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, ErrFlowStateMissing) {
253: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
254: 	}
255: 	snap, err := s.store.ReadArtifacts(sp)
256: 	if err != nil {
257: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
258: 	}
259: 	var prior []StageState
260: 	if stateLoaded {
261: 		prior = state.Stages
262: 	}
263: 	stages := DeriveStages(sp, snap, prior)
264: 	refreshed := NewFlowState(sp, stages, s.now())
265: 	if stateLoaded {
266: 		refreshed.Review = state.Review
267: 		refreshed.Smoke = state.Smoke
268: 		refreshed.QA = state.QA
269: 		if refreshed.Review != nil && refreshed.Review.Fingerprint != "" {
270: 			manifest, reviewFindings, reviewErr := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, ReviewRequest{})
271: 			refreshed.Review.Stale = reviewErr != nil || len(reviewFindings) > 0 || (strictCompletedReviewSnapshotFreshness && manifest.Fingerprint != refreshed.Review.Fingerprint)
272: 			if !refreshed.Review.Stale {
273: 				content, readErr := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageReview)
274: 				validationManifest := manifest
275: 				if !strictCompletedReviewSnapshotFreshness {
276: 					validationManifest.Fingerprint = refreshed.Review.Fingerprint
277: 				}
278: 				refreshed.Review.Stale = readErr != nil || len(ValidateReviewContent(content, validationManifest)) > 0 || refreshed.Review.ArtifactDigest == "" || hashBytes([]byte(content)) != refreshed.Review.ArtifactDigest
279: 			}
280: 		}
281: 		if refreshed.Smoke != nil {
282: 			smokePath, pathErr := ArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageSmoke)
283: 			data, readErr := os.ReadFile(smokePath)
284: 			invalid := pathErr != nil || readErr != nil || len(ValidateSmokeContent(string(data))) > 0
285: 			fingerprintMismatch := readErr == nil && refreshed.Smoke.SmokeFingerprint != "" && refreshed.Smoke.SmokeFingerprint != hashBytes(data)
286: 			reviewMismatch := refreshed.Review == nil || refreshed.Review.Stale || refreshed.Smoke.ReviewFingerprint != refreshed.Review.Fingerprint
287: 			refreshed.Smoke.Stale = invalid || fingerprintMismatch || reviewMismatch
288: 			refreshed.Smoke.Reconciliation = fingerprintMismatch || (readErr == nil && refreshed.Smoke.SmokeFingerprint == "")
289: 		}
290: 	}
291: 	if s.statusWrites && !legacyCodeContextState {
292: 		if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, refreshed); err != nil {
293: 			return StatusSummary{}, err
294: 		}
295: 	}
296: 	flowPath, err := FlowStatePath(s.root, sp)
297: 	if err != nil {
298: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
299: 	}
300: 	var executeState *ExecuteRunState
301: 	var historicalExecutionStatus string
302: 	loadedExecute, executeErr := LoadExecuteRunState(s.root, sp)
303: 	if executeErr != nil && !errors.Is(executeErr, ErrExecuteRunStateMissing) {
304: 		if legacyStatus, ok := LegacyTerminalExecuteStatus(s.root, sp); ok {
305: 			historicalExecutionStatus = legacyStatus
306: 		} else {
307: 			return StatusSummary{}, executeErr
308: 		}
309: 	}
310: 	if executeErr == nil {
311: 		executeState = &loadedExecute
312: 	}
313: 	runStatePath, err := ExecuteRunStatePath(s.root, sp)
314: 	if err != nil {
315: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
316: 	}
317: 	verification := VerificationStatus{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug}
318: 	if historicalExecutionStatus == "" {
319: 		var verificationErr error
320: 		verification, verificationErr = s.VerificationStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
321: 		if verificationErr != nil && !errors.Is(verificationErr, ErrFlowStateMissing) {
322: 			return StatusSummary{}, verificationErr
323: 		}
324: 	} else {
325: 		verification.Assessment = AssessmentNotApplicable
326: 		verification.NextAction = "Historical terminal execution evidence is preserved; modern review and smoke evidence is not available."
327: 	}
328: 	return StatusSummary{
329: 		Project:                   sp.Project,
330: 		Sprint:                    sp.Slug,
331: 		SprintRoot:                workspace.Rel(s.root, sp.Path),
332: 		FlowStatePath:             workspace.Rel(s.root, flowPath),
333: 		Stages:                    stages,
334: 		ExecuteState:              executeState,
335: 		HistoricalExecutionStatus: historicalExecutionStatus,
336: 		ExecutePath:               ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageExecute),
337: 		RunStatePath:              workspace.Rel(s.root, runStatePath),
338: 		Review:                    refreshed.Review,
339: 		ReviewPath:                ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReview),
340: 		Smoke:                     refreshed.Smoke,
341: 		SmokePath:                 ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSmoke),
342: 		QA:                        refreshed.QA,
343: 		Verification:              verification,
344: 	}, nil
345: }

904: func (s Service) FlowReasoning(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req FlowRequest) (FlowResult, error) {
905: 	if err := validateFlowTarget(req.To); err != nil {
906: 		return FlowResult{}, err
907: 	}
908: 	if req.To != StageAreaReasoning && req.To != StageReasoning {
909: 		return FlowResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported reasoning flow target %q", req.To)
910: 	}
911: 	sp, inputs, catalog, err := s.resolveSprintInputsForFlow(projectRef, sprintRef, !req.DryRun)
912: 	if err != nil {
913: 		return FlowResult{}, err
914: 	}
915: 	now := s.now().UTC()
916: 	if stringsTrim(inputs.Requirements) == "" || containsPlaceholder(inputs.Requirements) {
917: 		err := fmt.Errorf("requirements.md is empty or contains placeholder content")
918: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
919: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
920: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: req.DryRun, Stages: stages}, err
921: 	}
922: 	handbookManifest, handbookFindings := BuildHandbookManifest(s.root, sp, inputs, catalog)
923: 	if len(handbookFindings) == 0 {
924: 		data, err := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageTechnicalHandbook)
925: 		if err != nil {
926: 			handbookFindings = append(handbookFindings, finding("technical-handbook.md", "", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageTechnicalHandbook), "missing technical handbook", err.Error(), "Generate technical-handbook.md before reasoning."))
927: 		} else {
928: 			handbookFindings = append(handbookFindings, ValidateTechnicalHandbookContent(data, handbookManifest)...)
929: 		}
930: 	}
931: 	manifest, findings := BuildReasoningManifest(s.root, sp, inputs, catalog)
932: 	findings = append(findings, handbookFindings...)
933: 	sortSprintFindings(findings)
934: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
935: 		err := fmt.Errorf("reasoning prerequisites failed validation")
936: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
937: 		if !req.DryRun {
938: 			_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
939: 		}
940: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: req.DryRun, Stages: stages, Findings: findings}, err
941: 	}
942: 	if req.To == StageAreaReasoning {
943: 		return s.flowAreaReasoning(ctx, sp, inputs, req, manifest, now)
944: 	}
945: 	return s.flowFinalReasoning(ctx, sp, inputs, req, manifest, now)
946: }

287: 			refreshed.Smoke.Stale = invalid || fingerprintMismatch || reviewMismatch
288: 			refreshed.Smoke.Reconciliation = fingerprintMismatch || (readErr == nil && refreshed.Smoke.SmokeFingerprint == "")
289: 		}
290: 	}
291: 	if s.statusWrites && !legacyCodeContextState {
292: 		if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, refreshed); err != nil {
293: 			return StatusSummary{}, err
294: 		}
295: 	}
296: 	flowPath, err := FlowStatePath(s.root, sp)
297: 	if err != nil {
298: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
299: 	}
300: 	var executeState *ExecuteRunState
301: 	var historicalExecutionStatus string
302: 	loadedExecute, executeErr := LoadExecuteRunState(s.root, sp)
303: 	if executeErr != nil && !errors.Is(executeErr, ErrExecuteRunStateMissing) {
304: 		if legacyStatus, ok := LegacyTerminalExecuteStatus(s.root, sp); ok {
305: 			historicalExecutionStatus = legacyStatus
306: 		} else {
307: 			return StatusSummary{}, executeErr
308: 		}
309: 	}
310: 	if executeErr == nil {
311: 		executeState = &loadedExecute
312: 	}
313: 	runStatePath, err := ExecuteRunStatePath(s.root, sp)
314: 	if err != nil {
315: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
316: 	}
317: 	verification := VerificationStatus{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug}
318: 	if historicalExecutionStatus == "" {
319: 		var verificationErr error
320: 		verification, verificationErr = s.VerificationStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
321: 		if verificationErr != nil && !errors.Is(verificationErr, ErrFlowStateMissing) {
322: 			return StatusSummary{}, verificationErr
323: 		}
324: 	} else {
325: 		verification.Assessment = AssessmentNotApplicable
326: 		verification.NextAction = "Historical terminal execution evidence is preserved; modern review and smoke evidence is not available."
327: 	}
328: 	return StatusSummary{
329: 		Project:                   sp.Project,
330: 		Sprint:                    sp.Slug,
331: 		SprintRoot:                workspace.Rel(s.root, sp.Path),
332: 		FlowStatePath:             workspace.Rel(s.root, flowPath),
333: 		Stages:                    stages,
334: 		ExecuteState:              executeState,
335: 		HistoricalExecutionStatus: historicalExecutionStatus,
336: 		ExecutePath:               ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageExecute),
337: 		RunStatePath:              workspace.Rel(s.root, runStatePath),
338: 		Review:                    refreshed.Review,
339: 		ReviewPath:                ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReview),
340: 		Smoke:                     refreshed.Smoke,
341: 		SmokePath:                 ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSmoke),
342: 		QA:                        refreshed.QA,
343: 		Verification:              verification,
344: 	}, nil
345: }

583: func (s Service) FlowRequirements(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req FlowRequest) (FlowResult, error) {
584: 	if err := validateFlowTarget(req.To); err != nil {
585: 		return FlowResult{}, err
586: 	}
587: 	sp, catalog, docs, err := s.resolveSprintForRequirements(projectRef, sprintRef, !req.DryRun)
588: 	if err != nil {
589: 		return FlowResult{}, err
590: 	}
591: 	now := s.now().UTC()
592: 	prompt := RenderRequirementsPrompt(s.root, sp, catalog, docs)
593: 	if req.DryRun {
594: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: true, Message: prompt.Prompt}, nil
595: 	}
596: 	if s.runtime == nil {
597: 		err := fmt.Errorf("runtime is required for requirements flow")
598: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
599: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
600: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Stages: stages}, err
601: 	}
602: 	runtimeReq := s.runtimeRequest(prompt.Prompt, map[string]string{"project": sp.Project, "sprint": sp.Slug, "stage": string(StageRequirements)})
603: 	runtimeReq.Validation = s.requirementsValidationSpec(sp)
604: 	runtimeResult, err := s.startPlanningStageRun(ctx, sp, StageRequirements, runtimeReq)
605: 	if err != nil {
606: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
607: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
608: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
609: 	}
610: 	content, err := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageRequirements)
611: 	if err != nil {
612: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
613: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
614: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
615: 	}
616: 	findings := ValidateRequirementsContent(content)
617: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
618: 		runtimeResult, findings, err = s.repairGeneratedArtifact(ctx, runtimeReq, runtimeResult, ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageRequirements), findings, func() []ValidationFinding {
619: 			data, readErr := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageRequirements)
620: 			if readErr != nil {
621: 				return []ValidationFinding{finding("requirements.md", "", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageRequirements), "missing requirements", readErr.Error(), "Generate requirements.md.")}
622: 			}
623: 			return ValidateRequirementsContent(data)
624: 		})
625: 		if err != nil {
626: 			stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
627: 			_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
628: 			return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
629: 		}
630: 	}
631: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
632: 		err := fmt.Errorf("generated requirements.md failed validation")
633: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
634: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
635: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages, Findings: findings}, err
636: 	}
637: 	stages := flowRequirementsSuccessStages(sp, now)
638: 	if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now)); err != nil {
639: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
640: 	}
641: 	_ = s.cleanupPlanningStageSessions(ctx, sp, StageRequirements, runtimeResult)
642: 	return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages, Message: "requirements complete"}, nil
643: }

645: func (s Service) FlowSprintIndex(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req FlowRequest) (FlowResult, error) {
646: 	if err := validateFlowTarget(req.To); err != nil {
647: 		return FlowResult{}, err
648: 	}
649: 	sp, inputs, catalog, err := s.resolveSprintInputsForFlow(projectRef, sprintRef, !req.DryRun)
650: 	if err != nil {
651: 		return FlowResult{}, err
652: 	}
653: 	now := s.now().UTC()
654: 	if findings, prerequisiteErr := s.codeContextPrerequisite(sp); prerequisiteErr != nil {
655: 		stages := s.flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, prerequisiteErr, now)
656: 		if !req.DryRun {
657: 			_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
658: 		}
659: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: req.DryRun, Stages: stages, Findings: findings}, prerequisiteErr
660: 	}
661: 	if stringsTrim(inputs.Requirements) == "" || containsPlaceholder(inputs.Requirements) {
662: 		err := fmt.Errorf("requirements.md is empty or contains placeholder content")
663: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
664: 		if !req.DryRun {
665: 			_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
666: 		}
667: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: req.DryRun, Stages: stages}, err
668: 	}
669: 	prompt, promptErr := s.composeSharedRuntimePrompt(ctx, sp, inputs, RenderSprintIndexPrompt(s.root, sp, catalog, inputs.Docs))
670: 	if promptErr != nil {
671: 		stages := s.flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, promptErr, now)
672: 		if !req.DryRun {
673: 			_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
674: 		}
675: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: req.DryRun, Stages: stages}, promptErr
676: 	}
677: 	if req.DryRun {
678: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: true, Message: prompt.Prompt}, nil
679: 	}
680: 	if s.runtime == nil {
681: 		err := fmt.Errorf("runtime is required for sprint-index flow")
682: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
683: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
684: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Stages: stages}, err
685: 	}
686: 	runtimeReq := s.runtimeRequest(prompt.Prompt, map[string]string{"project": sp.Project, "sprint": sp.Slug, "stage": string(StageSprintIndex)})
687: 	runtimeReq.Validation = s.sprintIndexValidationSpec(sp, catalog)
688: 	runtimeResult, err := s.startPlanningStageRun(ctx, sp, StageSprintIndex, runtimeReq)
689: 	if err != nil {
690: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
691: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
692: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
693: 	}
694: 	inputs, err = s.store.ReadPlanningInputs(sp)
695: 	if err != nil {
696: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
697: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
698: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
699: 	}
700: 	index, findings := ValidateSprintIndexContent(inputs.SprintIndex, catalog)
701: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
702: 		runtimeResult, findings, err = s.repairGeneratedArtifact(ctx, runtimeReq, runtimeResult, ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSprintIndex), findings, func() []ValidationFinding {
703: 			updated, readErr := s.store.ReadPlanningInputs(sp)
704: 			if readErr != nil {
705: 				return []ValidationFinding{finding("sprint-index.md", "", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSprintIndex), "missing sprint index", readErr.Error(), "Generate sprint-index.md.")}
706: 			}
707: 			var updatedIndex SprintIndex
708: 			updatedIndex, findings = ValidateSprintIndexContent(updated.SprintIndex, catalog)
709: 			index = updatedIndex
710: 			return findings
711: 		})
712: 		if err != nil {
713: 			stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
714: 			_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
715: 			return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
716: 		}
717: 	}
718: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
719: 		err := fmt.Errorf("generated sprint-index.md failed validation")
720: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
721: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
722: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages, Findings: findings}, err

971: 		var refErr RefError

1079: func (s Service) planManifest(sp Sprint, inputs PlanningInputs, catalog project.ProjectIndex) (PlanManifest, []ValidationFinding) {
1080: 	var findings []ValidationFinding
1081: 	handbookManifest, handbookFindings := BuildHandbookManifest(s.root, sp, inputs, catalog)
1082: 	if len(handbookFindings) == 0 {
1083: 		if data, err := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageTechnicalHandbook); err != nil {
1084: 			handbookFindings = append(handbookFindings, finding("technical-handbook.md", "", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageTechnicalHandbook), "missing technical handbook", err.Error(), "Generate technical-handbook.md before plan."))
1085: 		} else {
1086: 			handbookFindings = append(handbookFindings, ValidateTechnicalHandbookContent(data, handbookManifest)...)
1087: 		}
1088: 	}
1089: 	findings = append(findings, handbookFindings...)
1090: 	reasoningManifest, reasoningFindings := BuildReasoningManifest(s.root, sp, inputs, catalog)
1091: 	findings = append(findings, reasoningFindings...)
1092: 	for _, entry := range reasoningManifest.ReasoningTemplates {
1093: 		path, pathErr := workspace.ResolveInside(s.root, normalizeWorkspacePath(entry.OutputPath))
1094: 		if pathErr != nil {
1095: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Area-Specific Reasoning Inputs", entry.Name, entry.OutputPath, "unsafe area reasoning path", pathErr.Error(), "Use a workspace-contained selected output path."))
1096: 			continue
1097: 		}
1098: 		data, readErr := s.store.ReadFile(path)
1099: 		if readErr != nil {
1100: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Area-Specific Reasoning Inputs", entry.Name, entry.OutputPath, "missing selected area reasoning", readErr.Error(), "Generate and validate selected area reasoning before plan."))
1101: 			continue
1102: 		}
1103: 		findings = append(findings, ValidateAreaReasoningContent(data, entry, reasoningManifest)...)
1104: 	}
1105: 	var reasoning string
1106: 	if len(findings) == 0 {
1107: 		data, err := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageReasoning)
1108: 		if err != nil {
1109: 			findings = append(findings, finding("reasoning.md", "", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReasoning), "missing final reasoning", err.Error(), "Generate reasoning.md before plan."))
1110: 		} else {
1111: 			reasoning = data
1112: 			findings = append(findings, ValidateFinalReasoningContent(data, reasoningManifest)...)
1113: 		}
1114: 	}
1115: 	manifest, planFindings := BuildPlanManifest(s.root, sp, inputs, inputs.SprintIndex, reasoning)
1116: 	manifest.ReasoningTemplates = reasoningManifest.ReasoningTemplates
1117: 	findings = append(findings, planFindings...)
1118: 	sortSprintFindings(findings)
1119: 	return manifest, findings
1120: }

reasoning_details.text:
Interesting: `OperationSmokeDryRun` (line 504) runs `ss.RunSmoke(... DryRun: true)` where `ss` is presumably a plain sprint service (read-only use case service). And `operationRuntimeIdentity` for OperationSmokeStart advertises "configured smoke author and harness" — confirming the operation is DESIGNED to run with a smoke author runtime. Yet sharedOperationRunner builds it without runtime. Where does the TUI/web smoke-start actually dispatch? OperationSmokeStart isn't handled in this switch (lines 485-545 show dry-run/status ops); it falls to default → u.runner (sharedOperationRunner). Confirmed: smoke-start via TUI/web → runner without runtime → guaranteed failure at authoring.

Also note line 504-510: web dry-run renders RenderSmoke(r) as content — fine.

Now, is there any chance sprintRuntimeService is intentionally omitted because deps lack runtime config in those contexts? No—same deps available; other cases use it. It's a wiring bug. F1 solid. Severity: high operability? The feature (TUI/web smoke start incl. diagnostic override) always fails AFTER writing Running attempt state and after preflight — user-visible failure with misleading guidance ("Configure the smoke model/runtime and rerun smoke" though runtime IS configured). Actually wait — guidance says configure model/runtime; operator HAS configured it (sprintRuntimeService would succeed). Misleading. Severity medium-high. Confidence high.

Let me also double-check `tui` uses sharedOperationRunner: tui/model.go nav item Operation → app hub ops → runOperation... default branch → u.runner = sharedOperationRunner. Yes (web/operation_handlers.go uses hub.ops too).

Next, verify remaining hypotheses quickly:

1. reviewFixture definition (test realism).
2. `resolveSprintTarget` create=false semantics.
3. `startSprintRuntime` (runtime.go?) — heartbeat/metrics writes to .runtime-metrics.json?
4. Whether RunSmoke's saveSmokeAttempt(Running) + terminal write can clobber a QA-owned flow state — SaveFlowState preserves Review/QA when nil. commitSmoke sets state.Smoke replacing whole record but keeps Review/QA since loaded. OK.

Also check gitpublish.Publish quickly for the harness publication path trust (paths under HarnessRoot published to public repo — authoring paths only, fine).

And one more candidate I haven't validated: **`prepareSmokeStatic` uses `entry.Manifest` from catalog; manifest path containment inside root; but `entry.Path` root canonicalized via canonicalDirectory (EvalSymlinks). TOCTOU symlink swap between canonicalization and child exec — local race, skip.

**`smokeEnvironment`**: settings.Environment may contain duplicates/invalid names from config? Config validated elsewhere presumably. Skip.

**DirectRunner env empty**: if settings.Environment configured to [] via config override → env slice empty → cmd.Env=[] → child has NO env (Go: Env==nil means inherit; empty non-nil means EMPTY). append([]string(nil), req.Env...) with req.Env empty non-nil? smokeEnvironment returns nil var env if no values → append(nil...) stays nil → cmd.Env=nil → INHERIT FULL PARENT ENV! Wait!! smokeEnvironment: `var env []string; for ... { env = append(env, ...) }` — if NO allowlisted var has a value, env stays NIL. Then Request.Env=nil → process.go line 86: `cmd.Env = append([]string(nil), req.Env...)` → append(nil-copy of nil) = nil → cmd.Env=nil → **exec.Cmd inherits the parent's ENTIRE environment**. So when the allowlist resolves to zero populated variables (e.g., PATH/HOME unset in a stripped service context, or config restricts Environment to vars that are unset), the harness silently receives the FULL unrestricted environment — exactly what the allowlist exists to prevent (secret leakage into external harness). More common trigger: operator configures Smoke.Environment=["SMOKE_TOKEN"] only, and SMOKE_TOKEN is unset in the invoking shell → env nil → full inheritance including API keys. That's a REAL security-relevant bug: fail-open env allowlist.

Wait, check DefaultSmokeSettings: Environment includes PATH/HOME/TMPDIR/LANG/LC_ALL — usually set, so env non-nil typically. But PATH could legitimately be absent in systemd units with restricted environments... then full inheritance anyway (defeating the restriction precisely when the parent env is minimal-but-present with secrets like AWS keys). The fail-open condition: every allowlisted name yields "" from getenv. Plausible in CI/service contexts. Test TestDefaultSmokeEnvironmentPreservesInterpreterPath uses values map where UNDECLARED_SECRET absent but PATH present → env non-empty → passes; the test never covers all-empty case. Confidence: high on mechanics (Go semantics: nil Env inherits parent). Severity: medium-high security (secret exfiltration channel to external harness), trigger requires all allowlisted vars empty. This is a strong finding. Let me double check Go docs: "Env specifies the environment of the child process. If Env is nil, the new process uses the current process's environment." Yes. # Sprint Smoke Gate — Deep Independent Review

Target: `ultraplan-go` @ `c6f01cf` (smoke files identical at HEAD). Build, vet, and `go test ./internal/sprint/ -run Smoke` pass. Context pack read; all claims below re-verified against source and tests directly.

## Findings

### F1 — Environment allowlist fails open to full parent-env inheritance
**Severity: Medium-High | Confidence: High | Security/trust boundary**

- **Claim:** When every allowlisted environment variable resolves empty/unset, `smokeEnvironment` returns a nil slice (`smoke_protocol.go:635-641`, `var env []string` never appended), which flows into `pprocess.Request.Env`, where `cmd.Env = append([]string(nil), req.Env...)` (`internal/platform/process/process.go:86`) yields nil → Go inherits the **entire parent environment** in the harness child.
- **Bad outcome:** The external smoke harness process receives all parent secrets (provider keys, tokens) — the exact leak "bounded environment forwarding" (TRD §18.9.2) and `smokeEnvironment` exist to prevent. Failure is silent: no diagnostic fires.
- **Trigger:** Operator sets `smoke.environment` to a custom allowlist (supported: `config.go:555,572-573`) whose vars are unset in the invoking shell; or any context lacking all five defaults. Both discovery (`smoke.go:93-97`) and run (`smoke.go:150`) inherit fully.
- **Execution proof:** Replicated the exact composition in `/tmp/opencode/envdemo`: nil Env child sees parent-only marker var (`INHERITED-FULL-ENV`); empty-slice Env correctly gets `EMPTY-ENV`.
- **Counter-evidence searched:** Default settings usually include PATH so common paths build a non-nil env; test `TestDefaultSmokeEnvironmentPreservesInterpreterPath` only covers the non-empty case — it cannot catch this. No code distinguishes "no values" from "no allowlist".
- **Regression test:** `smokeEnvironment(settings-with-unset-vars, …)` must return non-nil empty slice; add a process-level test asserting a child spawned via `DirectRunner{Env: <that slice>}` observes an empty environment.

### F2 — TUI/web smoke-start is constructed without a runtime and can never succeed
**Severity: Medium-High | Confidence: High | Operability / TRD §18.9.3 parity violation**

- **Claim:** `OperationSmokeStart` builds its service as `sprint.NewService(root).WithPublisher(...).WithSmokeSettings(...)` — no `WithRuntime` (`internal/app/operation_runner.go:80`), unlike every sibling case that uses `sprintRuntimeService` (`sprint_commands.go:754-779`). Non-dry-run `RunSmoke` unconditionally calls `authorSmokeSuite`, which returns `smoke_author_runtime` on nil runtime (`smoke_author.go:21-23`; reached via `smoke.go:82-87`).
- **Bad outcome:** TUI nav items "Run Smoke [EXTERNAL]" and the diagnostic-override variant (`tui/model.go:497-498`) and the shipped web operation ("Smoke test", `web/static/app.js:184`, route registered in `operations_contract_test.go:46`) always fail after preflight and after `saveSmokeAttempt` records a Running attempt (`smoke.go:31`) — durable failed-attempt litter plus misleading guidance "Configure the smoke model/runtime" though it *is* configured (CLI uses it at `sprint_commands.go:571`). `operationRuntimeIdentity` even advertises "configured smoke author and harness" for this op (`operations.go:657`). Violates TRD §18.9.3 "TUI… expose the same… smoke scope".
- **Counter-evidence searched:** Web dry-run works (`operations.go:504-510`, authoring skipped); TUI full-flow smoke works via `sprintRuntimeService` (`operation_runner.go:37,46`). No test executes OperationSmokeStart end-to-end, so nothing disproves or pins the breakage.
- **Regression test:** App-level test running `sharedOperationRunner` for `OperationSmokeStart` against a fixture workspace with a fake harness must complete with a committed verdict.

### F3 — Evidence root equal to harness root silently disarms the authoring-scope snapshot
**Severity: Medium | Confidence: High (mechanics) | Validation bypass of TRD §18.9.2**

- **Claim:** `validateSmokeManifest` rejects authoring path `"."` but never checks evidence roots against the harness root: `smokePathsOverlap(".","src/tests")` is false for every candidate (`smoke_protocol.go:236-248,581-585`), and `canonicalDirectoryInside(root, root)` passes because `inside()` accepts `rel == "."` (`artifacts.go:77-83`). With `evidence.runs = "."`, `smokeHarnessSnapshot` hits `inside(prepared.RunsRoot, path)` on the top directory and `SkipDir`s the entire tree (`smoke_author.go:353-356`) — before and after snapshots are both empty.
- **Bad outcome:** `changedSmokeHarnessPaths` returns `[]`, so the manifest-allowlist loop (`smoke_author.go:84-88`) is vacuous: the author agent may modify **any** harness file undetected; TRD §18.9.2 "Any other harness change … fails smoke" is not enforced, and drift isn't published either. Additionally runs/issues containment (`canonicalFileInside(p.RunsRoot, …)`, `smoke.go:347-357`) accepts any file in the harness as evidence.
- **Trigger:** Cataloged/harness-supplied manifest with `"evidence":{"runs":".","issues":"."}` — a shape nothing validates; a hostile or merely buggy harness upgrade can flip it unnoticed since every other gate stays green.
- **Counter-evidence searched:** Authoring-path overlap check does catch evidence roots that are proper ancestors of authoring dirs; only exact-root equality escapes. Runtime permission policy still restricts writes, but that policy is the same single defense the snapshot tripwire was built to backstop.
- **Regression test:** `validateSmokeManifest` must reject an evidence root whose canonical path equals the harness root (and roots equal to each other); snapshot test asserting non-empty coverage for such a manifest.

### F4 — Disabled freshness/identity switches contradict TRD and make smoke.md attest checks that do not run
**Severity: Medium (contract) + Low-Medium (false attestation) | Confidence: High**

- **Claim:** `strictCompletedReviewSnapshotFreshness`, `strictCompletedSmokeSnapshotFreshness`, `strictSmokeAuthorProtectedSnapshots` are compile-time `false` (`freshness_policy.go:11-14`). Consequences: (a) governed-input changes after review completion do not stale review/smoke — `prepareSmokeStatic` (`smoke_protocol.go:186-194`) and `Status` (`service.go:269-289`) only digest-check the artifact itself — contrary to TRD lines 2077 and 1846 ("A fingerprint mismatch makes the artifact stale"); (b) `authorSmokeSuite` skips target/project identity capture entirely (`smoke_author.go:39-50,89-106`), yet `RenderSmoke` unconditionally writes "Product source and governed sprint inputs were identity-checked before and after authoring" (`smoke.go:572`) into the durable governance artifact, and publication spreads it (`publication.go:111-119`).
- **Bad outcome:** A review completed against requirements R1 gates smoke after requirements were swapped to R2 (only content-format findings or artifact-digest edits would trip it); and every smoke.md records an integrity attestation that never executed.
- **Counter-evidence searched:** The in-code comment documents a deliberate temporary relaxation for *completed-state* staleness, but TRD carries no amendment, and the comment's claim that "the smoke harness authoring allowlist remain[s] enforced" does not cover the protected-target/project identity check, which is wholly absent. Residual controls: restricted permission policy + `UnsupportedCount` abort (`smoke_author.go:110-112`), review-fingerprint cross-check (`service.go:286`).
- **Regression test:** Either re-enable attribution-based checks or change RenderSmoke wording to match reality; contract test that editing a governed input post-review forces `VerificationStatus.Review.Fresh == false` (currently fails).

### F5 — Unanchored placeholder scan discards fully validated smoke results at commit time
**Severity: Low-Medium | Confidence: High | Availability of the commit gate**

- **Claim:** `commitSmoke` validates rendered output via `ValidateSmokeContent` → `containsPlaceholder`, a bare case-insensitive substring match for `todo`/`tbd` anywhere (`index.go:218-221`, `smoke.go:441-443`). Harness-authored open-issue fields (title/summary/theory/evidence/action) and the operator's `--override-reason` are embedded verbatim by `RenderSmoke` (`smoke.go:488,529-541`).
- **Bad outcome:** A run that passed every protocol/evidence check fails to commit because e.g. an issue summary contains "`// TODO` guard" — smoke.md is not updated, the verdict is lost, flow state records AttemptFailed, and guidance says "Generate a complete evidence-backed summary", which is false. Delivery gating blocks until prose is reworded and the external suite rerun.
- **Counter-evidence searched:** Fails closed (prior artifact preserved — verified by `TestQASmokeParity…PreservesItOnMalformedRun` pattern at `smoke_test.go:491-494`), but no control prevents the false rejection; no word-boundary logic exists.
- **Regression test:** `RenderSmoke` output containing an issue titled "capacity TBD" must either commit or the scan must be boundary-aware.

### F6 — Harness-controlled text is embedded into smoke.md without newline/structure sanitization
**Severity: Low | Confidence: High | Artifact integrity**

- **Claim:** `printable()` only trims and swaps backticks (`smoke.go:698-705`); issue free-text fields, evidence `Kind` strings, and prerequisite descriptions from the run response are interpolated raw into markdown (`smoke.go:502,511,526,536-541,555`). A response containing `\n` sequences injects arbitrary headings/lines into the persisted, published governance record. Parsed verdict can't be overridden (first-match `fieldBacktick`), but forged evidence lines/findings can be.
- **Counter-evidence:** Harness is semi-trusted and locally cataloged; paths and hashes are strictly validated while content is not — an asymmetry, not an exploit primitive by itself. Consequence limited to audit-record pollution.
- **Regression test:** Response fields containing `\n## Forged` render neutralized (single-line) in smoke.md.

### F7 — Evidence/issue hashing is unbounded during validation
**Severity: Low | Confidence: High | Reliability**

- **Claim:** `validateSmokeRun` stats then `hashFile`s each evidence/issue file with no size cap (`smoke.go:359-367,391`), and `refreshEvidenceFingerprint` re-hashes them (`verify.go:330-347`); `hashFile` reads whole-file (`smoke.go:707-713`). Every other reader in this surface bounds at 64 MiB (`smoke_author.go:200,371`; `verify.go:433`).
- **Bad outcome:** A multi-GB file under the declared runs/issues root (harness bug or stray output) OOMs or stalls the CLI mid-validation after the harness already ran.
- **Regression test:** Evidence file above a stated cap must produce the bounded-read smoke error class instead of unbounded allocation.

## Defended non-issues

- **All-skipped suite ⇒ verdict `pass`:** identities/counts are set-equality validated (`smoke.go:312-343`); default selection requires complete mapping with enumerated tests; narrow explicit scopes are forced diagnostic-only (`smoke_protocol.go:495-520`), so they can't commit as authoritative. TRD is silent on skip semantics.
- **Zero-test selection committing as pass:** impossible for non-diagnostic commits — complete mappings' suites are validated non-empty (`smoke_protocol.go:351-353`) and default blocked otherwise (`smoke_protocol.go:522`).
- **Discarded `refreshEvidenceFingerprint` error in `commitSmoke` (`smoke.go:463`):** `SaveFlowState` validates *before* rename (`state.go:248,286`), so an empty InputFingerprint fails safely with reconciliation error and prior state intact — no brick.
- **Single heartbeat vs 2h expiry:** `attemptExpired` checks OwnerPID liveness first (`verify.go:467-479`); live runs hold the mutation lease so reconcilers can't interleave (`locks.go:112-126`).
- **Blocked/not-applicable smokes publish without roadmap mark:** consistent with review-stage publication behavior; roadmap marking is pass-gated (`smoke.go:39-48` vs `publication.go:115-117`) — asymmetry is intentional evidence transparency.
- **Double `prepareSmokeStatic` on the success path:** executes under the mutation lease; worst case is an honest post-commit publication error.
- **Dry-run spawning discovery:** read-only preview semantics; documented next-action contract.
- **CLI arg surface:** `--timeout` capped at 24h, scope-flag exclusivity, override-reason coupling all enforced (`sprint_commands.go:909-961`).

The two highest-priority fixes are F1 (fail-open env trust boundary) and F2 (dead smoke-start on two of three frontends); F3 is the subtlest — it needs only one manifest field to disable the surface's central authoring-integrity tripwire.
